name: xrmtoolbox-plugin-dev
description: Build, debug, and ship XrmToolBox plugins (tools) for Dataverse / Dynamics 365 CE. Covers PluginBase/PluginControlBase scaffolding, ExportMetadata, ExecuteMethod + WorkAsync, the optional plugin interfaces, Visual Studio debug setup (including Windows-on-ARM), secret storage, and NuGet packaging to the Tool Library.
